name: Methoxyflurane

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 2001 — for liver harm and kidney harm

summary: Methoxyflurane was removed from the United States market starting in 2001 because it caused liver harm and nephrotoxicity, which means damage to the kidneys [3]. Meanwhile, a small computer model, rather than tests done on people, calculated low risk scores of 17 for the liver and 22 for the heart [M].
